role_place: Biblical scholar and translator (Vulgate); monk and presbyter in Bethlehem; the letters and polemical works of the NPNF2-06 volume.
why_relevant: Source of the Galatians commentary text (tares/leaven material) that Gratian and Aquinas cite and of Letter 109 (Deut 13 cited to justify shedding blood); also the source of the NT 'spiritual sword' contrast with the Old Law in Letter 14.
